title: HDB renovation cost
subject: flat
scope: What renovating a resale HDB flat in Singapore costs, line by line, at three finish levels. Prices are ranges in Singapore dollars; set the floor area, switch lines on or off and add a buffer.
limits: Anchored on 2026 whole-flat ranges from renovation guides (about S$55,000 to S$95,000 for a 4-room resale); the split into items is our estimate. Excludes professional fees, permit costs, moving and most appliances. Get itemised quotes before budgeting.

inputs.label: Floor area
inputs.note: A 4-room HDB flat is about 90 sqm.

options.label: Basic
options.note: Cosmetic refresh: overlay or vinyl flooring, minimal hacking, stock cabinets.

options.label: Standard
options.note: Typical resale renovation: new tiles, rewiring, custom carpentry.

options.label: Premium
options.note: Designer finishes, large-format tiles, full custom carpentry.
